preview.text: Saudi Arabia and Singapore meet in a T20 match at YSD-UKM Cricket Oval, where Saudi Arabia won the toss and chose to bat first. In their 3 recorded T20 meetings, Saudi Arabia won 3 and Singapore won 0. The usual first-innings score in the 10 recorded T20 matches at YSD-UKM Cricket Oval is 125, while the forecast for the next 8 hours shows up to a 100 per cent chance of rain and about 32 degrees.

summary.text: Saudi Arabia posted 174-7 from their innings led by Abdul Waheed Ghaffar with 54 off 32 balls, while Daksh Pratap Singh Tyagi took 3 for 38 for the bowling side. In reply, SIN reached 97-7 with Daksh Pratap Singh Tyagi top-scoring with 18 off 17 balls, and Usman Khalid claimed 2 for 16 as Saudi Arabia won the match by 75 runs.
